name: What factors determine the cost of storm-related drywall replacement?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of storm-related drywall replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Replacing drywall after a storm ranges from a few hundred dollars for a minor leak patch to several thousand dollars for multiple rooms or ceilings. Final costs depend on the square footage involved, ceiling height, whether wet insulation or custom framing repairs are needed, and the level of interior finish work. A simple replacement requires new sheetrock, tape, mud, and texture matching. If the project also requires rebuilding structural framing, replacing baseboards, or color-matching multi-room interior painting, overall labor and materials expand accordingly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on the affected square footage, ceiling heights, required insulation or framing repairs, texture matching complexity, and finish carpentry or painting needs.
